title: Light Table
description: Mounted slides and orange-masked negative strips shot from Beatles sleeves (With the Beatles, A Hard Day's Night, Rubber Soul, Magical Mystery Tour, Let It Be) on a glowing light table. Slide the film around the glass and stack two transparencies into a double exposure.
intent: One optical material finished to the edge: real transparencies over a real light source, where stacking multiplies light and a negative only gives up its picture when you know how to read it.
